package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/diagnosticplan"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"io"
	"mime"
	"net/http"
)

type DiagnosticAssessmentPlanHandler struct{ Issue diagnosticplan.Issuer }

func (h DiagnosticAssessmentPlanHandler) IssuePlan(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	media, _, contentErr := mime.ParseMediaType(r.Header.Get("Content-Type"))
	key := r.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key")
	parsed, keyErr := uuid.Parse(key)
	if contentErr != nil || media != "application/json" || keyErr != nil || parsed.String() != key {
		writeDiagnosticError(w, domain.ErrMalformed)
		return
	}
	var input domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRequestV1
	d := json.NewDecoder(http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, 64<<10))
	d.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if e := d.Decode(&input); e != nil || d.Decode(&struct{}{}) != io.EOF {
		writeDiagnosticError(w, domain.ErrMalformed)
		return
	}
	plan, created, e := h.Issue.Issue(r.Context(), r.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key"), input)
	if e != nil {
		writeDiagnosticError(w, e)
		return
	}
	status := http.StatusOK
	if created {
		status = http.StatusCreated
	}
	writeDiagnosticJSON(w, status, plan)
}
func writeDiagnosticError(w http.ResponseWriter, e error) {
	status, code := http.StatusInternalServerError, "internal_error"
	switch {
	case errors.Is(e, domain.ErrMalformed):
		status, code = http.StatusBadRequest, "malformed_request"
	case errors.Is(e, domain.ErrValidation):
		status, code = http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "invalid_request"
	case errors.Is(e, domain.ErrNotFound):
		status, code = http.StatusNotFound, "not_found"
	case errors.Is(e, domain.ErrConflict):
		status, code = http.StatusConflict, "idempotency_conflict"
	case errors.Is(e, domain.ErrUpstreamUnavailable):
		status, code = http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "upstream_unavailable"
	case errors.Is(e, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid):
		status, code = http.StatusBadGateway, "upstream_invalid"
	}
	writeDiagnosticJSON(w, status, map[string]any{"error": map[string]string{"code": code}})
}
func writeDiagnosticJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, p any) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(p)
}
